title: Parameters for the MORAI Vehicle Interface Node

address.description: MORAI PC address. Code default: env MORAI_SIM_ADDRESS, else 10.10.10.1 (the rig MORAI PC). Read once at start-up.

port.description: MORAI gRPC port. Code default: env MORAI_SIM_PORT, else 7789.

ego_name.description: ObjectInfo.id.value of the ego actor (a string, MORAI default 'Ego').

command_deadline_ms.description: Lower bound of the ControlVehicle deadline [ms] (main.py cmd_rpc_timeout_s). Effective value = max(this, 4 x MORAI round trip p50), capped at max(1000, this) (main.py cmd_timeout_for_rtt).

keepalive_time_ms.description: gRPC keepalive period [ms]; 0 disables it (MORAI's ping policy is not yet known).

forward_control_to_sim.description: If false, control, gear and control-mode requests are not sent to MORAI (manual driving with the simulator keyboard). Runtime-changeable.

steer_cmd_sign.description: Sign applied to the steering command. Deliberately NOT symmetric with the hard-coded -1 on the report side. Runtime-changeable.

steer_comp_enable.description: Divide the steering command by the speed-dependent MORAI steering-deficit gain. Runtime-changeable.

steer_comp_speeds_mps.description: Compensation table speeds [m/s], strictly increasing. Runtime-changeable.

steer_comp_gains.description: Compensation table gains (0.5-1.5, same length as speeds). Runtime-changeable.

send_pedal_with_accel.description: In acceleration mode also fill throttle/brake pedals. Runtime-changeable.

velocity_cmd_unit.description: Unit of VehicleCtrlCmd.velocity (Autoware m/s x 3.6 | x 1 | 0). Read once.

cmd_stale_timeout_s.description: A control_cmd older than this is replaced by a braking command that keeps the last steer [s]. Read once.

cmd_stale_accel.description: Acceleration of the stale braking command [m/s^2]; must be negative. Read once.

command_trigger.description: What triggers ControlVehicle (added 26.09.25 for an A/B against main.py). update = exactly one per accepted MORAI update, from the engine loop (default). timer = a dedicated command thread sends the latest command at cmd_resend_hz with absolute deadlines and no catch-up bursts (main.py _CmdResender); the engine loop then does not send. Same command building, stale brake, NaN, forwarding and duplicate-writer rules in both. Runtime-changeable.

cmd_resend_hz.description: ControlVehicle rate when command_trigger is timer [Hz] (main.py name and default). Unused with update. Integers are accepted. Runtime-changeable.

gear_resync_s.description: Resend the target gear if MORAI's gear differs, at most this often [s]. Read once.

gear_retry_s.description: Retry period after a failed gear send [s]. Read once.

ego_mode.description: gt = the MORAI Ego is the Autoware vehicle; follow = pseudo-VILS, stream the real-car localization (follow.input_topic) to the MORAI Ego with SetTransform and send no commands, teleports, TF, vehicle status or control_mode_request (Ego status goes to /morai/ego/*); localize = VILS with a vehicle-PC ghost, publish the MORAI Ego as localization only (kinematic_state, map->base_link TF, localization init) and write nothing to MORAI (no commands, gear, mode, teleport, lamps or control_mode_request; Ego status goes to /morai/ego/*). Read once.

twist_source.description: ego_mode localize only. vehicle = fill the kinematic_state twist with the real-car wheel speed (/vehicle/status/velocity_status) and the pose heading rate; morai = keep the MORAI Ego values (only when the vehicle PC gives the ghost a speed). Read once.

velocity_max_age_s.description: Use the pose-derived speed (diagnostic WARN) when the real-car speed is older than this [s]. Read once.

window_s.description: Window for the pose-derived speed and heading rate [s]. Read once.

max_pose_age_s.description: Do not send poses older than this [s]. Read once.

lead_s.description: Extrapolate the pose this far ahead to cover RPC latency [s]. Read once.

z_source.description: Ego z sent to MORAI. Read once.

fail_timeout_s.description: Diagnostic ERROR when no SetTransform succeeded for this long [s]. Read once.

ghost.description: Send ControlVehicle(GHOST, real-car speed km/h) before each SetTransform and set the Ego control mode to AUTO on connect. Read once.

daq_brake_full_bar.description: Brake pressure [bar] that maps to DAQ brake 1.0 (real car, follow mode). Read once.

publish_ground_truth.description: Publish /localization/kinematic_state, map->base_link TF and TrackedObjects, and initialise localization (GT mode). Read once.

steer_report_hold.description: Hold the last steering report when MORAI reports an idle-record 0. Runtime-changeable.

steer_report_ignore_foreign.description: Replace the steering report with the last value we sent on frames whose applied steering was not sent by this node. Runtime-changeable.

steer_input_norm_deg.description: Steering angle [deg] that MORAI front_wheel_angle 1.0 stands for (used to tell our values from foreign ones). Runtime-changeable.

teleport_on_initialpose.description: Move the MORAI ego to /initialpose (RViz 2D Pose Estimate). Runtime-changeable.

time_source.description: Stamp source: MORAI sample time (ActorStates.timestamp) or local receive time. Read once.

publish_clock.description: Publish /clock with the message stamp (the MORAI sample time with time_source morai; receive time otherwise or when the MORAI timestamp is unusable) every update. Read once.

max_sample_age_s.description: Diagnostic ERROR when no new valid sample for this long [s]. Read once.

actor_hold_s.description: Reserved, currently no effect: actors come from the same GetAllActorsState as the ego, so they cannot go stale separately (no new sample = no TrackedObjects). Read once.

clock_offset_warn_ms.description: Diagnostic WARN when |median(MORAI timestamp - receive time)| exceeds this [ms]. Read once.

fallback_hz.description: Poll+send rate when WaitForTick cannot be used [Hz]. Read once.

auto_reassert_auto.description: After a reconnect, set MORAI back to AUTO if it reports KEYBOARD and AUTO was last requested. Read once.

engage_on_start.description: Set MORAI to AUTO on the first connection. Read once.

sensor_model.description: If set, mount that sensor kit's sensors on the MORAI ego once. Empty = do not touch sensors (GT mode). Read once.

duplicate_writer_guard.description: Block ControlVehicle (after a ~0.3 s brake if it was sending) while another publisher of /vehicle/status/velocity_status exists; self is excluded by publisher GID. false = detect and report only. Read once.

publish_daq.description: Publish the ViLS DAQ topics <daq.topic_prefix>/{ego_status,object_status} (morai_ros2_msgs EgoVehicleStatus, ObjectStatusList) and <daq.topic_prefix>/vehicle_cmd (Autoware Control) from the same MORAI snapshot the node already reads (replaces daq_publisher.py). Read once.

mode.description: gated = publish only while <daq.topic_prefix>/run_state (latched std_msgs/String 'active <run>' / 'idle <run>', sent by cue_server around each bag) is active; always = publish continuously. Runtime.

rate_hz.description: DAQ publish rate [Hz] (spec 100 Hz; a zero-order hold of the ~50 Hz MORAI updates). Read once.

max_sample_age_s.description: Stop the state topics and count gap ticks while the latest MORAI sample is at least this old [s]. Read once.

cmd_stale_s.description: Stop /daq/vehicle_cmd when no new control_cmd arrived for this long [s]; zeros are never invented. Read once.

accel_scale.description: Scale applied to MORAI acceleration (daq_publisher --accel-scale). Read once.

publish_collision.description: Publish /daq/collision (morai_ros2_msgs/CollisionData from gRPC Ego vehicle_state.collision_objects). Read once.

stamp.description: sample = MORAI sample time (repeated rows share a stamp) and the original control_cmd stamp; tick = publish time (daq_publisher behaviour). Offline tools use the bag receive time either way. Read once.

run_timeout_s.description: End a run automatically after this long without 'idle' (cue_server died) [s]; 0 = never. Read once.

topic_prefix.description: Topic prefix; must match daq/spec.py. Read once.

raw.description: Raw gRPC recording (added 26.09.26). Also publish <daq.topic_prefix>/raw/actor_states (one std_msgs/String per accepted MORAI update: the complete GetAllActorsState response as proto3 JSON, schema morai_raw.actor_states/1) and <daq.topic_prefix>/raw/vehicle_ctrl_cmd (one per ControlVehicle call: the VehicleCtrlCmd exactly as sent plus stale/ok/grpc_code/rpc_ms/result_status, schema morai_raw.vehicle_ctrl_cmd/1). Values are not converted. Same gate as the other DAQ topics; JSON is built on the DAQ thread. Requires publish_daq. Read once.

raw_queue_depth.description: Depth of each raw queue from the engine/command threads to the DAQ thread (added 26.09.26). On overflow the oldest item is dropped and counted (raw_dropped / tx_dropped in the run summary). Read once.

enable.description: Disturbance injection (added 26.11.10, MRDIST-1). true = create the service ~/set_disturbance (morai_ros2_msgs/srv/SetDisturbance: position offset/noise, probabilistic dropout, blackout on the ground-truth objects sent to Autoware) and, with publish_daq in ego_mode gt, publish <daq.topic_prefix>/disturbance (one morai_ros2_msgs/DisturbanceStatus per object frame, about 10 Hz) and <daq.topic_prefix>/object_status_disturbed (needs daq.publish_objects) under the same gate as the other DAQ topics. The ground-truth DAQ topics are not changed. In ego_mode follow/localize the service exists but every ON command is rejected with REAL_CAR. false = node behaves exactly as before. Read once.
